No, you are not allowed to add one more 3-credit elective at this time. 

The reasons and details are as follows:

* **Credit Limit & Overload:** You currently have 25 credits registered [SQL]. Your CGPA is 8.82 [SQL]. Under the credit limits policy, a student with a CGPA of 8.5 or higher (CGPA 8.82 ≥ 8.5) may register for up to 28 credits with the written approval of the Head of Department [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §3 Credit limits per term]. Adding a 3-credit elective would bring your total to 28 credits (25 + 3 = 28), which reaches the absolute maximum limit.
* **Add/Drop Period Deadline:** More importantly, courses may be added or dropped only during the add/drop period, which ended 14 days after classes began (for the 2026-ODD term, it ended on 10 August 2026) [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4 Add/drop period]. 
* **Current Status:** Today's reference date is 23 Nov 2026. Because the add/drop period has passed, no course can be added [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4 Add/drop period].
sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.full_name, d.code AS department, s.year_of_study, s.cgpa, COALESCE(SUM(c.credits) FILTER(WHERE e.status = 'enrolled'), 0) AS credits_registered FROM students AS s JOIN departments AS d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.student_id = e.student_id AND e.term = '2026-ODD' LEFT JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.student_id = 'S2023ENTC001' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.full_name, d.code, s.year_of_study, s.cgpa LIMIT 200
